mathematics.assertion_tested: Derivatives of the authenticated charged-pion vacuum and HB nucleon kernels give normalized mixed mass-shape ratio one at retained chiral orders; local constant/analytic-M2 projections, chiral RG chain rule, fixed-ratio mass-convention terms and sequential-limit restrictions hold in the listed symbolic basis
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact symbolic real expressions, positive M,F,Z,g; formal nonnegative e2
mathematics.conventions: Natural units; canonically normalized e=0 pion coordinate M; fixed positive quark-mass ratio, strong reference scale and strange mass; fixed UV quark and chiral subtraction scales; charge derivative at e2=0 before M->0; chirally regular matching conventions
inputs: source-authenticated same-order local meson and baryon operators
next-order analytic M2 and M2 logarithmic EFT mass basis

bounds.leading_mesonic: O(e2 p2) susceptibility, divided by LO pure-QCD susceptibility
bounds.leading_baryonic: O(e2) local and O(e2 p) pion-cloud mass
bounds.next_mass_basis: M2 log^k M2 with k=0,1,2 for mesons and k=0,1 for baryons
bounds.mass_limit: M->0+ after charge derivative at zero
bounds.RG: single leading logarithm and its matching-constant running

non_claims: No full-QCD all-orders proof or finite-mass equality
No target alpha, fitted LEC, c_H or geometric stress-energy
Unexpanded finite-charge kernels only diagnose order-of-limits nonuniformity

checks.check: process exited successfully within enforced limits
declared result files are present and regular

result: Run completed; mathematical assertion requires interpretation and review.
residual_risks: Command success does not establish the mathematical interpretation.
Only listed input artifacts are pinned; external dependencies need recorded versions.
The thread cap uses conventional environment variables; a child program may ignore them.
The POSIX CPU-time limit is per process, not an aggregate descendant budget.
